posts.title: Travelog: Vietnam, Phu Quoc, 2025
posts.description: Phu Quoc is a beautiful island in Vietnam, known for its stunning beaches, clear waters, and vibrant culture. I had the opportunity to visit Phu Quoc in 2024 and 2025, and it was a pleasant experience. The island is near Cambodia and Thailand, so in November and December, the weather is better here.
